Enum Class AnimationType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<AnimationType>
de.tum.cit.fop.maze.Drawing.AnimationType
All Implemented Interfaces:

public enum AnimationType extends Enum<AnimationType>
Enumeration of all available animation types in the game. Used to identify and retrieve specific animations from the texture map.
